Selection barriers

Why dental recommendations can mislead patients

Dental practices may advertise broad service groups without defining specialists and appointment conditions.

01

Different dental disciplines are combined

Therapeutic dentistry, surgery, prosthodontics, orthodontics and pediatric care require different clinical skills and indications.

02

A headline procedure price appears final

Advertised starting prices can exclude examination, laboratory steps or additional procedures. Individual plans depend on clinical assessment.

03

Equipment becomes an outcome promise

A scanner, microscope or implant brand does not establish that a given procedure will achieve a guaranteed result for every patient.

Verifiable facts

Reliable information for choosing dental care

The Russian Health Ministry's Order 786n governs specified adult dental services, with changes under Order 696n effective October 2026. Medical licensing applies to specific work types, while Article 20 of Healthcare Act 323-FZ addresses informed consent. These legal instruments do not verify individual treatment outcomes.

  • Specialty: licence scope, location, treating dentist's qualifications and relevant age coverage
  • Service: consultation content, examination, possible stages, choices and transparent pricing scope
  • Trust: permitted reviews without disclosure of personal health information, real scheduling and up-to-date clinician pages

This is a GAEO sector methodology, not a measured dental clinic client result or medical claim.

FAQ

Questions about the service

Can dental GEO target implant queries?+

Yes, where relevant professional services and consultation conditions are verified. General marketing content should not imply universal clinical suitability.

How should pricing work when the plan is individual?+

Show consultation and diagnostic fees alongside any clearly defined procedure stages. A complete plan follows examination and informed discussion.

Are adult and pediatric dentistry covered identically?+

Not necessarily. Service age limits, qualified professionals and relevant procedures should be verified for each practice.

Can a clinic show before-and-after patient photos?+

Only with appropriate permission, medical confidentiality and compliant advertising. These photographs must not imply guaranteed outcomes.

How much does dental GEO cost?+

GAEO's published plans apply. Scope depends on branches, specialties, dentists and the prompt matrix.
